title: Changeset simulation
statement: The system shall simulate a changeset on an in-memory copy and report validation errors, dangling references, the MECE delta, the traceability delta and the blast radius without writing.
rationale: Reverse-engineered from the implemented reqforge 0.2 behaviour.

acceptance_criteria.text: Creates with $refs and story remaps simulate as valid without writing anything
Deleting a referenced record without remapping is reported as a dangling reference
A new overlapping requirement makes mece_ok false
